case_title: ANTHONY JAMES BRAXTON VS. MICHAEL BRAXTON

docket_entries.description: ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT BRAXTON, MICHAEL MCGRAW, CHRISTOPHER
ORDER CASE CONTINUED FOR STATUS UPDATE. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-06-2023 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO JUN-13-2023 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF ANTHONY JAMES BRAXTON IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT MICHAEL BRAXTON IS PRESENT WITH WITNESS CHRISTOPHER MCGRAW. CHRISTOPHER MCGRAW STATED IN COURT THAT HE IS AGREEING TO BE ADDED AS A NAMED DEFENDANT IN THE CASE AND WAIVES SERVICE. COURT ORDERS CHRISTOPHER MCGRAW AS A NAMED DEFENDANT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR DEFENDANT CHRISTOPHER MCGRAW PAYING COSTS OF REPAIR TO THE AUTO SHOP FOR THE PLAINTIFF. COURT ORDERS PLAINTIFF ANTHONY BRAXTON TO PROVIDE WRITTEN DOCUMENT SUCH AS COST, START DATE OF REPAIR, INVOICE BILL/ESTIMATE AND ALL SUPPORTING DOCUMENTS TO THE COURT VIA DEPT. 506 EMAIL AND COPYING DEFENDANTS MICHAEL BRAXTON AND CHRISTOPHER MCGRAW BY MARCH 20, 2023 (WITHIN 2 WEEKS). COURT ORDERS DEFENDANT CHRISTOPHER MCGRAW TO PROVIDE UPDATE STATUS TO THE COURT VIA DEPT. 506 EMAIL AND COPYING PLAINTIFF ANTHONY BRAXTON AND DEFENDANT MICHAEL BRAXTON TO PROVIDE CONFIRMATION, ASSUMING THE RESPONSIBILITY FOR REPAIR AND THAT THE AUTO SHOP ACCEPTS THE SAME BY APRIL 3, 2023 (WITHIN 2 WEEKS). APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE JUNE-13, 2023, 3:30 P.M. HEARING IF THE AGREEMENT IS BROKEN IN WHICH A JUDGMENT WILL BE ENTERED. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; DEPUTY RON. CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
